findings.actor: estimator using AI Copilot; or any consumer of activity history for AI-touched rows
findings.workflow: (a) Copilot builds a package -> apply -> rows inserted with totalDelta recorded; (b) activity history row projection reads adjustment fallback
findings.precondition: row with both adjustment_percentage and contingency_percentage set, OR with quantity_base present and contingency_percentage set
findings.input_fixture_id: synthetic row with quantity_base=2 quantity_contingency_amount=0.5 contingency_percentage=10 adjustment_percentage=null
findings.expected_commercial_result: canonical rule: adjustment = adjustment_percentage ?? (quantity_base==null ? contingency : 0) = 0 (because quantity_base is present)
findings.actual_result: THREE divergent fallback rules: (1) d1-intents/rows.ts:329 readNumber(adjustment_percentage, contingency_percentage) -> falls back to contingency unconditionally; (2) ai/package-builder/apply.ts:2210/2244 -> no fallback (treats missing as 0); (3) ai/package-builder/draft.ts:1848 -> falls back to contingency unconditionally; (4) ai/package-builder/draft.ts:1853 + schemas.ts:1415 -> uses contingencyPercentage only, ignores adjustment entirely. apply.ts:1298 history totalDelta omits adjustment AND contingency.
findings.delta_exact_values: row above resolves to 0 under canonical; to 10 under rules 1+3; to 0 under rule 2; to 10 under rules 4. apply.ts:1298 totalDelta = qty*rate+misc (no adjustment) underreports the row's true financial impact.
findings.source_to_output_trace: Copilot draft -> apply -> estimate_sheet_events.total_delta REAL persisted. d1-intents/rows.ts:324-356 rowItemHistoryResult builds the activity history row breakdown read by the activity UI.
findings.d1_rows_affected: estimate_sheet_events.total_delta for AI-applied rows persists the wrong magnitude
client_facing_surfaces_affected: activity history row breakdown for AI-inserted rows
findings.existing_pack_disposition: NEW_OWNER_HERE — no active pack owns the AI package-builder formula convergence. (AI surfaces are pre-release; the Copilot is feature-flagged.)
findings.root_cause: Each AI module (draft, schemas, apply, read-tools) reimplements the row total independently with different fallback rules; the canonical validator is not invoked at the AI computation boundary.
findings.smallest_fix_direction: Route every AI package-builder row total through computeEstimateRowCostParts; eliminate the four local copies.
findings.data_repair_need: none (AI-applied rows are pre-release; no production data)
findings.acceptance_evidence: AI draft preview, budget summary, and apply history totalDelta match the canonical oracle for the same input

findings.actor: estimator duplicating an estimate or creating a new estimate
findings.workflow: (a) duplicate estimate -> 4 sequential batches; (b) create estimate + default tab -> 2 sequential ops
findings.expected_commercial_result: graph mutation is atomic — either fully committed or fully rolled back
findings.actual_result: duplicateEstimateRecordGraph (estimate-records.ts:247) runs 4 sequential awaits (estimate insert -> tabs insert -> nodes insert -> rows insert) with NO receipt tying them and NO compensation. createEstimateRecordWithDefaultTab (estimate-records.ts:222) runs 2 sequential ops. If a later step fails, prior steps are committed -> orphan estimate (with tabs but no nodes/rows, or with tabs+nodes but no rows). No reconciler detects or cleans up such orphans.
findings.delta_exact_values: orphan/partial estimate rows in D1 on failure
findings.silent_vs_explicit: silent (orphan exists; user sees an empty/broken estimate with no error)
findings.persistence_recovery_behavior: NONE — no reconciler. Manual recovery only.
findings.reproducibility: requires injected failure; logic confirmed via source inspection
findings.existing_pack_disposition: PARTIAL CROSS_REFERENCE_ACTIVE_PACK — Quality Master UNIT-015 (D1 batch atomicity, CRITICAL, READY) owns the broader database.batch() fail-before-write gate. The graph-level atomicity for duplicateEstimateRecordGraph specifically is NOT covered by UNIT-015. NEW_OWNER_HERE for the graph envelope.
findings.root_cause: The 4-step graph duplication predates the runMutationWithHistory + receipt pattern; it was never wrapped in a single envelope batch.
findings.smallest_fix_direction: Either (a) issue all 4 steps' statements in a single database.batch() with a graph-level receipt, or (b) add a post-failure reconciler that detects estimates with tabs-but-no-rows and quarantines them.
findings.data_repair_need: scan for existing orphan estimates (estimates with zero estimate_row_items but non-zero estimate_tabs)
findings.acceptance_evidence: injected failure at step 3 leaves no partial estimate; or reconciler detects and flags orphans
findings.recovery_fix_forward_plan: Wave 1: envelope the 4 batches. Wave 2: orphan reconciler cron.

findings.actor: user comparing XLSX totals to share page totals
findings.workflow: publish estimate -> open share link -> download XLSX -> compare grand totals
findings.precondition: any published estimate with default contingency 10% + VAT 12%
findings.expected_commercial_result: XLSX Grand Total and share page Proposal total either match or their difference is documented on the share page
findings.actual_result: XLSX Summary applies sheet adjustment + contingency + VAT (visible line items). Publication snapshot totalCostMinorUnits is proposal_included_direct ONLY (no contingency, no VAT, no sheet adjustment). Share page displays totalCostMinorUnits. So XLSX Grand Total > share page Proposal total by exactly the charges. The divergence is BY DESIGN but is the single largest inter-surface numeric divergence and is NOT documented on the share page.
findings.delta_exact_values: for direct=100000, contingency=10%, VAT=12%: XLSX grand = (100000 + 10000) * 1.12 = 123200. share page total = 100000. delta = 23200 (23.2%).
findings.source_to_output_trace: create-proposal-workbook.ts:419-514 totals block vs publication/snapshot.ts:295 calculationBasis: 'proposal_included_direct'
findings.silent_vs_explicit: silent (no notice on share page that the XLSX has higher total)
findings.existing_pack_disposition: NEW_OWNER_HERE (product/UX decision, not a defect). Possibly co-owned with MVP UNIT-010 (contractor profile + branded export) which will surface terms.
findings.root_cause: publication snapshot was designed as direct-cost-only; the XLSX is the issued proposal with charges.
findings.smallest_fix_direction: product decision: either (a) surface a note on the share page clarifying the XLSX includes taxes/contingency, or (b) extend the snapshot to carry a finalProposal basis alongside the direct basis.
findings.acceptance_evidence: share page either matches XLSX or carries an explanatory note
findings.recovery_fix_forward_plan: Product/UX decision; minimal code if option (a).
